overview:
Ridgetop Research is a San Francisco-based expert network specializing exclusively in the technology sector. Founded in 2018, the company focuses on SaaS, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and growth-stage technology companies, serving PE firms and growth equity investors with deep tech-native expertise.

The company's SaaS benchmarking capabilities differentiate it from generalist networks — Ridgetop can provide not just expert calls but also data-driven comparisons of SaaS metrics (ARR growth, net retention, CAC/LTV, churn) across portfolio companies and acquisition targets. San Francisco headquarters provides natural proximity to the technology ecosystem.
